**Verdict: PASS** for DG2 round 7 on candidate `sha256:ede1a936…16de` (532 files, source `90439483`), with one new Low finding.

I checked the candidate ID before starting and again at the end, and it matches both times. During my run HEAD moved to `844fa08` (another reviewer's evidence and a round-8 assignment). I didn't open those files, and the ID was unchanged. Everything ran on a disposable clone, which I deleted afterwards, and in both locale settings (`LANG`/`LC_ALL` unset, and `LANG=C.UTF-8`).

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| Typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI lint (161 operations), no-CDN, format, contrast, historical DG1 check | all exit 0 |
| Unit tests | 9/9 runs pass, 673/673 each, on Node 22 and Node 24, including one under CPU load |
| Integration | 5 completed runs per locale (one under load each), all 531/531 with 0 skipped. This covers migrations 0001→0019, DB guards, contract (161 routed), blank-text, encoding, invalid-character and framework-errors |
| Integration plus my own QA suites | 571/571 in each locale |
| Product e2e, English and Arabic, including Define→G2 and Design→G3 | 62/62 in each locale |
| My acceptance journey (`qa-stack.sh`) | 114/114 in each locale, with `server_encoding UTF8` in the log |
| Accessibility (axe) | 592 screens, 0 violations of any severity |
| Validator `--register DG2`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile` | all pass |

- **Integration determinism:** the orchestrator's failure (one file failing at setup, 11 skipped) did not come back. `framework-errors.test.ts` and `admin.test.ts` ran 24 times across both locales and under load, all green, including 12 runs of just those two files. That event is still unexplained.
- **Lone surrogates and framework errors:** I wrote a new round-7 spec (`docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-7/e2e/dg2-qa-r7.spec.ts`), and it passes in English and Arabic.
  - A lone surrogate is refused inline with the localized message. The real server answers 400 `validation.invalid_character` at the right field, nothing is written, and emoji plus Arabic text is still accepted.
  - Over a real socket, all 7 error cases (`%ZZ`, a percent-encoded lone surrogate, a bad SPA path, an oversized header, an oversized URL, a malformed request line) answer 400 `application/problem+json` with the same security headers as normal responses.
- **Residuals** (registry D-057, CI D-058, Keycloak D-049): recorded as PASS on their offline or config surface, each with its residual noted.

**Failed runs, all explained:**
- **Two integration attempts never started** (exit 3). PostgreSQL could not bind its port ("Address already in use"). Every port the test harnesses use, including all their defaults, is inside Linux's ephemeral range (32768–60999). A recently closed client connection on that port blocks the bind; I reproduced this on its own. Both runs passed when repeated on other ports. This cannot be the orchestrator's failure, because the port error stops the run before the tests start.
- **The first acceptance-stack attempt** failed with "Cannot find module". Playwright also picked up my committed evidence copies of earlier specs, the same harness problem as in round 6. I removed them in the clone only and reran green.

**New finding:**
- **F-DG2-310, Low, not mandatory, owner devops-engineer:** the disposable-PostgreSQL harness ports sit in the ephemeral range, which causes these occasional start-up failures. It is test tooling only and fails safely (BLOCKED, never a false pass). Two of the four affected harnesses are my own files, so I gave it to the stack-tooling owner rather than verify my own fix.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-7/`:
- qa-verifier.json (validates against the schema)
- qa-verifier.findings.json
- qa-verifier.md

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-7/`. As qa-verifier I grant no business approval, and product gate G6 never implies DG7.
